protocol_amendments.scope: Stage 2 only; recorded after Stage-1 holdout and before any Stage-2 score was inspected.
protocol_amendments.reason: The initial draft did not state the exact STE transform domain; one contemplated same-model q10 comparator would be tautologically identical to the candidate.
protocol_amendments.resolution: Keep the Stage-1 q10 mask and all fixed weights/thresholds unchanged. Compute STE on the ungated fold-valid domain, apply q10 only to legal emission pixels, and compare the candidate with the fresh same-fold ungated H-D/H-H blend, frozen ungated best, and seeded same-domain uniform emission.

target: Fault geometry absent from the supplied known-fault catalogue; not direct geothermal-vent prediction.
novelty_scope: Repository, archived hypothesis ledger, and bounded 54-repository public artifact/document inventory only; no global novelty claim.

current_best_proxy.candidate: H-D/H-H fixed 50:50 probability blend + STE L9/w=0.35/spacing=2.4
current_best_proxy.truth: Visible known-fault catalogue; not hidden organizer labels.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Componentwise physical strain-budget residual as a coarse prior
ranked_hypotheses.operator: 10 km source-geometry fault tensor using Kreemer et al. (2000) Eq. 3; subtract matching scalar modeled dilation/shear from observed source layers; combined prior = equal-weight mean of percentile ranks of the positive parts of the two raw residuals; fixed q10 allowed-domain threshold.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Positive geodetic dilation/shear not accommodated by the mapped-fault tensor in a broad tile.
ranked_hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: Unaccommodated deformation may reflect unmapped structures, but can also be off-fault, aseismic, or source/model error; the scalar residual does not locate a fault.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: The older HK1 gate is rank(geodetic second invariant)-rank(fault second invariant), not separate dimensional dilation/shear subtraction. Existing vector_budget scalar residuals have not been evaluated under this buffered spatial holdout or paired Stage-2 q10 protocol.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_direction: Weak positive enrichment is plausible at Stage 1; Stage-2 DTI direction is unknown and must beat the frozen local best to promote.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Moderate-to-high; geometry-based held-block source-row exclusion, four physical unit/component sensitivity cases, six Stage-2 detector folds, then all final-byte gates.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: None; use restored source-verified INGENIOUS/QFault traces and geodetic layers.
ranked_hypotheses.promotion_status: SELECTED; holdout pending; no submission slot unless preregistered Stage-2 rule passes.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Stress-favored independent basement edges
ranked_hypotheses.operator: Project an independently derived local stress orientation onto candidate-edge orientations and test stress-favorability interactions against edge-only and stress-only controls; do not use known fault geometry as candidate truth.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A subsurface contact/edge whose orientation is compatible with slip or dilation under a documented ambient stress tensor.
ranked_hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: A buried structure may be stress-favored but lack a surface scarp; lithologic contacts and interpolated stress are alternatives.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H-H uses edge endpoints and conductive relays; no current arm projects stress tendency onto candidate lineaments. The USGS release reports tendencies on mapped fault segments, so transfer to new edges needs independent justification.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_direction: Low-to-moderate positive only if label-independent stress extrapolation is defensible; otherwise no-go.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; official metadata lists 34.25 MB full-study and 27.35 MB INGENIOUS shapefiles, but archive download, field audit, stress semantics, projection, and spatial validation remain outstanding.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: Free official USGS ScienceBase data release; availability verified in the item metadata, not yet downloaded/field-audited.
ranked_hypotheses.promotion_status: UNTESTED; blocked pending stress-field and field-semantics audit.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Cross-catchment knickzone alignment
ranked_hypotheses.operator: Extract hydrologically conditioned longitudinal profiles and score persistent stream-gradient breaks that recur in neighboring catchments and align with an independent potential-field/basement edge.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A structural base-level/gradient break repeated across separate drainage systems at a consistent mapped coordinate.
ranked_hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: A concealed fault may offset channels or establish a persistent break without a clear scarp; lithologic, volcanic, capture, and base-level effects confound it.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Existing code evaluates scarp coherence, odd/even profiles, and lineament endpoints, not longitudinal drainage profiles or cross-catchment recurrence.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; drainage conditioning, profile extraction, scale stability, and spatial holdout are required.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: No new acquisition assumed; uses restored DEM-derived layers. USGS 3DEP is the official source context.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Seismicity ridge interacting with an independent structure edge
ranked_hypotheses.operator: After exact density-band metadata verification, test persistent seismic-density ridges that intersect or parallel an independent geophysical edge against seismic-only and edge-only controls.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A spatially coherent earthquake-density corridor co-located with an independently mapped subsurface discontinuity.
ranked_hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: Active concealed faults may organize seismicity; diffuse swarms, catalog incompleteness, and aseismic faults are alternatives.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Seismicity layers are ordinary baseline predictors; no explicit cross-physics interaction is implemented. H51-K4 remains blocked on precise band semantics.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_direction: Low and uncertain; no numerical uplift claim.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-to-medium only after the layer parameter/source audit; otherwise blocked.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: No new data for the first screen; use supplied layers only after metadata review.

stage1.rate_component_status: Unresolved by official field definition; vertical remains sensitivity case.
stage1.source_rate_field: SLIPRTNUM; official field definitions say SLIPRT2023 is assigned mm/year and SLIPRTNUM its numeric portion.
stage1.primary_sense_policy: Use SLIPSENSE primary only. Do not add SECONDARY as a second full-rate component because no separate rate partition is documented; report local secondary-field counts/combos.
stage1.unknown_sense_policy: Omit unsupported/blank primary senses and report count; no silent normal-fault imputation.
stage1.geodetic_unit_note: The source README says 10E-9/yr. 10E-9 equals 1e-8 arithmetically, but the notation may have been intended to mean 1e-9; retain both.

residuals.dilatation: observed geod_dilaterate tile mean minus modeled fault-tensor dilatation in matching source units
residuals.shear: observed geod_shearrate tile mean minus source-defined principal-strain shear summary of modeled tensor
residuals.combined_prior: equal-weight mean of rank(max(dilatation residual,0)) and rank(max(shear residual,0)) over valid tiles

stage1.holdout: same six truth-bearing blocks as the 3x3 spatial Stage-2 split; exclude every official source record whose actual geometry intersects the held block plus 12-pixel buffer before calculating its Stage-1 budget
stage1.threshold: q10; approve score >= 10th percentile; no threshold search
controls: geodetic-only equal-weight mean of positive dilation/shear ranks, without mapped-fault subtraction
limitations: Visible catalogue truth is a proxy, not hidden expert truth.
A scalar residual may be off-fault, aseismic, or due to errors in slip rates, dip/rake assumptions, trace geometry, unit conversion, or geodetic smoothing.
A tile residual cannot locate a fine-scale fault.
Dilatation and shear scalar subtraction is not subtraction of full observed and modeled tensors.

stage2.model: Freshly refit H-D and H-H arms blended 50:50 by probability within each fold; no Stage-1 feature or labels enter either Stage-2 fit.
stage2.emission: Compute the fixed STE score on the ungated fold-valid domain (ridge scales 1/2/3.5 px; line length 9; continuity exponent 0.35), then apply the q10-approved mask only as an emission constraint; spaced selection 2.4 px.
stage2.holdout: six 3x3 spatial folds, 12 px training buffer, 250000 negatives, seed 1000+fold, HGB 250 iterations, mass ratio 3.47, 2 px known-catalogue exclusion
promotion_rule: q10-constrained Stage-2 mean exceeds the frozen ungated local best and its fresh same-fold ungated baseline
paired q10-constrained versus ungated DTI is positive on at least 4/6 folds and in the six-fold mean
all Stage-2 points are confined to q10-approved tiles
mean approved area >= 2/3 and implied Stage-1 lift <= 1.5
q10-constrained Stage 2 exceeds seeded, same-domain uniform spaced emission by at least 0.002 mean proxy DTI
stage2.full_map_diagnostic_mass: 44069 points, fixed only to match the existing local-best artifact's mass; not an estimate of hidden truth size.
stage2.failure_handling: A diagnostic TIFF may be written only after holdout, marked RESEARCH ONLY / DO NOT SUBMIT. No competition slot is authorized by local proxy or format/uniqueness checks.
